as_read: Conflicting on intestinal gas, and no abstract read gives a randomized charcoal-alone trial with a stated dose and a named primary outcome; the one positive diarrhea RCT states no dose.

quote.text: Commonly employed doses of activated charcoal do not appreciably influence the liberation of fecal gases.

proposed_decision_text: The labels print activated charcoal or charcoal powder at 520 mg to 1500 mg per serving, some with a general digestive purpose. This is an abstracts-only review, and no study read meets the rule for credit. The stored trial reports lower breath hydrogen, bloating and cramps versus placebo in 99 adults after lactulose, but the abstract states no dose, doesn't say it was randomized and names no primary outcome (PMID 3521259). A double-blind study after a baked bean meal found no difference at 4 g and concluded charcoal does not influence gas formation (PMID 3917957), and five volunteers taking 0.52 g four times daily, the amount closest to these labels, had no significant change in fecal gas or abdominal symptoms in an uncontrolled before-and-after study (PMID 9934757). A randomized double-blind trial in 100 adults with nonspecific diarrhea reports reduced stool frequency and duration, but the abstract states no dose (PMID 16739360). Dyspepsia trials tested combinations with simethicone or with simethicone and magnesium oxide (PMID 19349130, PMID 21478070). Gout and kidney studies tested charcoal alongside febuxostat or dialysis care, at gram doses or as open-label or small unblinded work, and are purposes these labels do not print (PMID 41547464, PMID 38107705, PMID 38146721, PMID 22697887).
clinician_items: 12516788: 75 g superactivated charcoal slurry in healthy volunteers: constipation or abdominal fullness 12/24, nausea 5/24, vomiting 2/24 versus 0 on control.
11139541: 5 g four times daily on three cycle days in 11 oral contraceptive users, 3 h after the pill and at least 12 h before the next: no ovulation.
41547464: adverse events similar across arms at 4.5 g and 7.2 g with febuxostat, 348 patients.
stored_rating_note: positive_moderate rests on 3521259 alone, which the stored applicability text already notes gives no dose. Null studies 3917957 and 9934757 are not in the stored record.
unread_notes: Abstracts only. 3717809 and 2731683 have no abstract in PubMed (double-blind gas studies), so they are not described. 16739360 is a German paper; its dose would be in the full text, not opened, and a stated mg dose there could make it a rule 2 study, which would change this route to packet_no_credit. Not opened: 34381357 and 16564934 (AST-120, a spherical carbon drug these labels do not print), 8171288, 23794285, 29186529.
